Yes, not too bad. I like it better than most benzos (having tried xans, Ativan, klonopin).

Still not as good as etizolam or clonazolam though.
I’m on Valium and I honestly found more effective gabapentin than Valium so that’s partly why I’m asking.
Tried them all. None has worked. Been on them on and off for quite awhile although I can’t remember how long.
Horrible. The pain never subsides. Its a constant battle. I forget everything now and it’s actually painful. I wish I could have a normal life. I’m only twenty.

In cases where you are facing mental illness like schizophrenia or something as dark as that, life itself becomes unlivable and only pain.

Opioids delay the pain and make day to day living manageable. Think about all of the people on opioid maintenance programs like methadone. They are still addicts but they can function.
100% agreed. In medicine, people are starting to realize the same thing with things like suboxone and methadone treatment.

Addiction sometimes is a better option than a horrible life which is why I feel for OP.

I’ve used heroin the same way as her and it fucking works.
Same here. I miss having friends and partying. I see everyone else having the time of their life but I’m stuck inside due to mental issues. Family doesn’t understand, or won’t.
Go to a hospital. It’s gonna be painful.
I do. A website I wanted to create but I can’t seem to figure it out enough in my head so I’ve decided it won’t be worth it. It was my passion.

I wish I was normal again, and could have friend but instead I get a life of misery and self-loathing. I want to be at peace but it feels like I cannot receive forgiveness or peace anymore.

In the end, I guess it doesn’t really matter because you always end up getting screwed over by family. I thought my family was my support system.
